Indian growth names such as Eternal, Persistent and Trent are showing relative strength. The portfolio was built this week and is fully invested, with all positions well above their stop-losses. Round-trip costs on US symbols are about 1.5%, so I'm holding and not chasing.

Global markets are mixed but holding up. The Nasdaq and S&P 500 closed modestly higher, the Fed held rates, and the Nifty keeps failing near 22,800 resistance. Brent near $114 is a macro risk, but it supports the defence holding. The portfolio is diversified (average correlation 0.09, worst month about -4%), so I'm putting some idle cash into one high-momentum US growth name and not churning.
